text:
sam: Seeing a bunch of gRPC streaming stalls in us-west-2a since ~09:00 UTC. Hosted inference streams are pausing mid-response — token tail latency spikes.
ops-bot: ALERT: high retransmit rate detected on link node-usw2a-10 <-> node-usw2a-11 (netmon)
maria: Yep, noticed user sessions where the stream stops sending tokens for ~5-20s then resumes. Logs are full of repeated write timeouts from the stream writer.
devin: ran tracepath between the two nodes, shows MTU drop on hop 1 after encap
```
$ tracepath 10.2.1.11
 1?: 1500 pmtu 1500
 2?: 1500 pmtu 1450
```
aj: We rolled kube-proxy yesterday and changed the cluster network offload flags for Geneve. That will add ~50 bytes of encapsulation; if host MTU wasn't adjusted, packets can exceed node MTU and get dropped when DF=1.
linh: Hypothesis: encapsulation increases packet size, Path MTU Discovery ICMPs are being dropped on the path (or not delivered back to pod), so TCP never shrinks MSS and gRPC streams hit retransmit and application-level stalls. This matches the token-tail pattern for long-lived HTTP/2 streams.
maria: Seeing lots of ICMP "Fragmentation needed" in tcpdump on the egress interface. Example:
```
12:34:56.789 IP 10.2.1.10 > 10.2.1.11: ICMP frag needed, mtu 1450
```
aj: Quick mitigation options: clamp MSS on encapsulating nodes (iptables --clamp-mss-to-pmtu), enable tcp_mtu_probing, or set tunnel MTU smaller. Long term need to standardize host MTU for encap + NIC offloads.
linh: Proposed minimal rollback: daemonset that sets /proc/sys/net/ipv4/tcp_mtu_probing=1 and adds iptables rule:
```
iptables -t mangle -A FORWARD -p tcp --tcp-flags SYN,RST SYN -j TCPMSS --clamp-mss-to-pmtu
sysctl -w net.ipv4.tcp_mtu_probing=1
```
maria: Note: disabling GSO/GRO on the nic would avoid fragmentation but will blow CPU for GPU-heavy inference nodes — costy. Prefer MSS clamp first.
devin: tcpdump before fix showed sustained retransmits on the connection used by the inference RPCs; after clamp on canary we see retransmits drop to zero and stream resumes normally. Snip:
```
BEFORE: 1000+ retransmits / 30s
AFTER: <5 retransmits / 30s
```
infra-bot: Canary rollout: created DaemonSet "net-mss-clamp-canary" on nodes node-usw2a-10,node-usw2a-11 (changeset cs-2026-118).
sam: Can we hold Dedicated GPU scheduling onto that nodepair until we validate? The cost of retries + retries holding GPU for paused sessions is significant.
aj: Paused scheduling for those nodes and applied canary. Monitoring token tail-latency and retransmit counters.
maria: Canary stable for 15m, tail latency back to baseline, no more streaming stalls. Will roll to remainder of us-west-2a with 10m stagger.
linh: Follow-up: file infra ticket to add MTU verification to node bootstrap (check encap overhead + NIC mtu) and add e2e test that simulates geneve encap for streaming workloads. Also include guidance for kube-proxy/network upgrades.
sam: Opening infra ticket INFRA-4821; tagging eng-ml & ops for postmortem. Thanks all :thumbsup:
